environment_used.fuel_moisture: configuration demo value; not inferred from ERA5 RH

fire_initial_position.accuracy_note: Point geometry requested from the current USFS service in EPSG:4326. The publication's stated minimum location precision is a PLSS section (one-square-mile grid); event-specific accuracy is not provided here.

inputs.weather: ERA5 record fetched and retained in input receipt; not used because ERA5 wind is at 10 m and SimFire expects midflame wind, while RH is not fuel moisture.

limitations: The FPA-FOD point is an incident reference with unknown event-specific precision, not GPS-confirmed ignition.
LANDFIRE FBFM13 vintage is 2016; it predates the 2021 fire by five years.
The 30-minute run demonstrates real fuel/terrain array integration only; its demo atmosphere is not historical weather.
The fetched ERA5 date is stored in UTC and is not aligned to discovery HHMM because the source timezone is unresolved.
The output is not a counterfactual reconstruction or a claim about real-world area saved.
